nom: SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 30 Day Miracle Exfoliating Toner

avis.texte: I got this about a year ago and started to use it and was so excited because it started to actually take my brown dark spots away. but then I got some cystic acne... so is stopped.. it eventually went away after about 3 months. so I tried again.. a week later same thing cystic acne. so disappointed because it was actually working. not sure what in the product caused it. super bummed

I have rough texture on the side of my nose and on my chin and I couldn't find anything that worked for it except for this! I bought the toner and the face wash and they are fantastic. They work without being too harsh. They are gentle and effective

I bought this toner after using Buttah Skin's Rose Water Toner for years and having my skin evolve and build up what I believe was a tolerance to that product (great product too, I plan to switch back to it when my skin gets used to this toner). This cleared up my stubborn acne marks, brought gunk out of my pores, and got rid of a large nodule on my cheek that wouldnt go away for over a month, all in about 10 DAYS!!! Background on my skin: its not acne prone, I break out like once a year but when I do its usually a series of pimples that leave marks, its typically hormonal or from product building up in the pores from me not taking off my makeup properly. this is a well formulated toner. I absolutely recommend this. it worked a miracle and QUICKLY.

I had super high hopes for this toner just based off of the reviews, but it fell short for me! I have combo acne prone skin (not irritated easily). I definitely noticed a positive change in my overall texture and can confirm 100% this helped reduce sebum production on my nose and my chin area. However, this was not soothing and did end up breaking me out along my jaw line. Be careful using daily, even if you aren't normally sensitive to products.. I have a feeling the tea tree just didn't jive with me. No alcohol in the formula so your hydration is safe! Overall a good product that works for many different skin types, just not for me!
I've had issues with an acne cluster on the side of my cheek. I use this in the morning and retinol at night and its finally almost gone after months of trying different products

I have combination acne prone skin , mostly hormonal. I suffer from closed comodones mainly and overall dull textured skin that made my makeup look terrible. I picked this up after realizing maybe I need a combination of acids to help my skin . This changed my life in the one month of use , I can tell the difference and will be repurchasing when Im done with this bottle .

Do yourself a favor & just BUY THIS! I randomly came across this product & thought I'd give it a shot without knowing anything about it... When I tell you I was truly amazed, I'm not lying. This product is gently enough for daily use, doesn't dry out my skin & smoothed my textured areas within days.
Gentle enough for my acne prone skin that i can use it every night. I've noticed a big difference in my blackheads and surface level acne. Will repurchase
This toner worked great for getting rid of the fungal acne on my forehead and sideburns. It smells kind of peppermint like but isnt strong, feels great on my skin.

avis.titre: My holy grail for acne skin! Definitely repurchase again :)
avis.texte: I always get acne around my cheek and chin area especially during that time of the month. I have been trying so many products but due to my sensitive skin it always irritated my skin. I have been hearing a lot about this Miracle toner that has gotten so many good review and decided to give it a try. My skin now has no acne and this product does not give me irritation at all. I notice my makeup also look better when i used it for my skincare routine. Definitely give it a try if you have hormonal acne!
